qualification: two-replica sustained HTTP and crash recovery

seed.method: authenticated actual HTTP commands only; opening counts are disclosed synthetic fixtures

sustained_http.client_schedule: independent continuous client loops without think time or an operator barrier
sustained_http.measurement_limit: Authenticated loopback HTTP and JSON processing; Python clients open HTTP connections per request; browser rendering, human timing and physical scanner input are excluded
sustained_http.action_latency_scope: command submission from the client's cached review through committed write and its own validated post-commit full warehouse refresh and, when enabled, exact literal serial source/custody review; initial review and subsequent exact replay excluded
sustained_http.throughput_scope: all completed client cycles, including initial reviews, physical commands, post-commit refreshes when enabled, conflicts and exact cross-replica replays; replay is not another physical move
sustained_http.snapshot_coverage: exact configured catalog SKU set and every seeded order ID/state, with completed history permitted

acceptance.scope: Synthetic workload acceptance; unset latency/throughput limits establish no facility SLO

qualification_limit: Local synthetic single-host and single-PostgreSQL-primary rehearsal. API replica survival and PostgreSQL crash recovery were tested; database failover, host loss, deployed latency, native receivers and physical facility acceptance were not.
